entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production transparent PIXEL ART sprite for a wooden Japanese coastal ship: a tiny square wooden cabin window with a sleeping sailor visible inside. Final game sprite 16x16 logical pixels. Simple warm honey-brown timber square frame, very dark indigo interior, a small warm tan face with closed eyes and a white headband resting on folded arms along the lower sill. No surrounding wall, no background, no text or Z symbols (the game adds those), no glow, no shadow. True transparent background around the square silhouette. Handcrafted 16-bit pixel-art with clean chunky pixels and one-pixel dark outline, 8-12 flat colours, no antialiasing, no blur. Front-on orthographic, centred with wide transparent margin, no perspective skew. This is a compact readable sleeping-crew window, not a detailed portrait. Match warm cedar ship wood, slate navy shadows, ivory cloth.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite for a pixel-art crew-management game, a new Japanese coastal trading ship. Draw ONE complete ship only, no scene, no sea, no sky, no people, no lettering. Actual transparent background. Landscape canvas 1536x1024. Composition: long low wooden ship, bow pointing LEFT, stern RIGHT, broadside three-quarter view from slightly above so its broad open deck is visible, matching classic 16-bit adventure game ship sprites. Entire ship within canvas, 4% transparent margin. A tall single wooden mast and handsome cream square sail made of vertical sewn panels, spars and taut thin ropes. Distinctive Japanese coastal merchant-ship character: upward curved pointed bow, dark indigo lower hull, warm cedar/honey planking, restrained vermilion rail trim, low small stern shelter with a simple dark curved roof at the far right, a long steering oar. No pirate cannons, no western ship wheel, no pagoda, no dragon head, no flag or emblem. The horizontal deck should be spacious, empty and unobstructed from roughly 15% to 80% of width, with the bottom of the sail ending ABOVE the deck, a clear hatch toward the left-middle, mast foot near center, simple low rails. Hull occupies bottom third; sail/mast upper two-thirds. Style: beautiful handcrafted crisp low-resolution pixel art, logical sprite around 460x270 pixels enlarged cleanly; chunky coherent pixel clusters, one-pixel dark navy outlines at logical resolution, limited warm earthy palette with 4-5 distinct cel-shaded wood tones, carefully placed small pixel highlights, creamy ivory sail shadowed with pale tan, consistent upper-left light. Readable silhouette, tasteful detail, clean steps and pixel clusters, no blur, no antialiasing, no painterly noise, no realistic rendering, no glossy 3D. Keep the design attractive and elegant at actual game resolution. ONLY the ship, genuine transparent alpha.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished wide pixel-art coastal background panorama for a 16-bit adventure game. Generate an opaque landscape 1536x1024 PNG. Beautiful Japanese coastal island densely crowned with flowering sakura / cherry-blossom trees, seen from a ship passing around its curved coast. NO ship, NO people, NO UI, NO text. Composition: pale clear sky in the upper third, a distant muted blue headland on the far left horizon, the main rocky island emerging from the RIGHT side and bending around into the middle distance, layered pink and warm white blossom canopies across its rounded top with small dark trunks, deep sage-green undergrowth, terraced grey-green rock ledges, a thin warm pale sand rim, clear teal water curling around the shoreline. Leave the LEFT half largely open sky and distant water and the LOWER third entirely open sea for a separately layered ship. Main blossom crowns visible on upper-right quadrant, island's left tip no farther left than 40% of image width. Three or four restrained angular pale clouds. The water is deep marine teal with sparse crisp pale blue horizontal ripples, getting darker towards the bottom. Early afternoon spring light, peaceful, warm and inviting. Style must be attractive deliberate PIXEL ART, logical 480x320 scene upscaled with nearest-neighbor, chunky coherent pixel clusters, stepped edges, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients, no brushwork or high-frequency texture, no photographic realism, no 3D. Restrained palette, at most about 32 colours: muted slate blues, blue-green sea, desaturated sage vegetation, charcoal-blue rock shadows, rich warm pink #df8ea1, blush #efb5bd and ivory #f5ddce blossom highlights. Clear light/shadow shapes, lively organic silhouettes. Match a honey-brown wooden ship sprite with dark navy outlines and ivory sail. No temples, no torii gates, no buildings, no volcano, no floating petals obscuring the view. This is an atmospheric pixel-game background, NOT a framed painting; fill the entire canvas edge to edge.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART sprite sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 12 separate full-body Japanese merchant sailors in a perfectly regular 4-column by 3-row grid; each cell same size, no grid drawn, no labels. Canvas 1024x1024. All 12 sprites show the SAME sailor and same outfit: adult Japanese deckhand with navy indigo short work jacket, warm cream trousers cropped at ankles, simple dark shoes, white headband, black hair, warm medium skin. Friendly small classic 16-bit adventure-game proportions, about 2.8 heads tall, not anime big-eyed, no caricature. One-pixel dark navy outline at logical resolution, flat cohesive 4-colour fabric shading, warm tan skin pixels, clear readable hands and feet. Each sprite will be reduced to about 20px wide and 32px tall, so use chunky readable shapes with no tiny noisy details. Sprite centered in each equal cell, feet on exactly the same baseline in every cell, entire body inside each cell with wide clear gaps, no shadows, no ground, no backdrop. Orthographic game view from slightly above. Row 1: (1) standing facing viewer arms relaxed, (2) front walk left foot forward, (3) front walk passing feet, (4) front walk right foot forward. Row 2: (1) side profile facing RIGHT standing, (2) side walk facing RIGHT left foot forward, (3) side walk passing feet, (4) side walk facing RIGHT right foot forward. Row 3: (1) leaning slightly forward pulling an invisible rope with both hands to the RIGHT, (2) same pulling pose hands drawn back close to chest, (3) waiting facing viewer one hand on hip, (4) resting seated cross-legged facing viewer. Exactly twelve figures, identical scale and character, no props, no weapons, no hats. Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no glow, no soft edges, no gradients, no rendered 3D. OPAQUE pixels for each body, completely transparent empty areas.

Edit the supplied sailor sprite sheet to make a SECOND crew appearance for the same pixel game. Preserve the EXACT 4-column by 3-row layout, all 12 poses, body proportions, scale, frame centers, feet baselines, clear spacing, crisp pixel clusters and transparent background. Make this character an adult Japanese woman sailor, hair tied neatly in a short low bun beneath the same white headband. Change the indigo jacket to muted brick-red / russet cloth, the sash to dark brown and trousers to warm light cream. Keep practical seafaring clothes, simple dark shoes, restrained friendly face, no exaggeration. Same upper-left illumination, dark navy one-pixel outlines, about 20x32 logical pixels per figure. Retain clear opaque bodies and fully transparent empty areas, remove any soft outer glow or ground shadow. No labels, no additional figures, no text, no props. Change ONLY character appearance and fabric colours; keep every pose and sheet registration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-game WATER RIPPLE TILE, true transparent PNG. A flat seamless field of about a dozen short, irregular HORIZONTAL sea ripple highlights and small curved foam tips. No solid background: everything between the ripples fully transparent, no gradient, no glow, no shadow. Landscape 1536x1024. Art intended for a 96x64 logical-pixel tile in a Japanese coastal ship game. Sparse dark teal #11667b, medium teal #2d8496 and muted light blue #68a6b5 ripple strokes, with very few ivory #d0e2db bright tips. Distinct deliberate clusters, most strokes 6-18 logical pixels long and 1-2 pixels tall, balanced negative space, spaced into loose staggered rows. No top-down circles, no objects, no land, no ship, no droplets, no text. Crisp 16-bit pixel art and genuinely transparent background. Repeat smoothly left-right and top-bottom without a visible rectangular boundary. Upper-left illumination, calm-to-moderate sea, sharp nearest-neighbour pixels.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit this exact pixel-art sakura coastline into a NIGHT version for a game day/night crossfade. Preserve every island edge, all tree and rock silhouettes, shoreline, horizon, clouds, water ripple placement and image dimensions exactly. Change lighting and colours only. Deep quiet indigo night sky; slate-blue shadowed cliffs; blossom crowns still readable in dusty mauve, subdued rose and cool pale lavender highlights; dark teal sea with restrained cool reflections. Add only a handful of tiny one-pixel pale stars in existing open sky; NO moon, no new objects, no glowing magic, no buildings, no lanterns. Preserve crisp pixel clusters and the calm atmosphere, no blur or bloom. Keep enough tonal separation for the island to remain beautiful and recognisable. Full opaque background. Do not move or redraw the coastline or reframe the scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. One production transparent PIXEL ART sprite: a curved foamy ship wake trailing behind a wooden coastal ship travelling LEFT. A narrow bright curled bow of white foam at left, two tapering trails sweeping gently toward the upper-right, conveying a ship rounding a coast. Seen from slightly above in broadside game perspective, low and wide, final logical size about 100x30 pixels. Landscape 1536x1024 but keep all wake inside a centered horizontal band, genuine transparent background everywhere else and between foam streaks. Restrained stepped pixel clusters in pale seafoam ivory #d0e2db, muted turquoise #68a6b5, dark teal #2d8496. Handcrafted 16-bit game sprite, crisp jagged organic edges, no blur, no soft glow, no shadow, no solid water rectangle. No ship, no land, no lettering, no other objects. NOT a circular splash, NOT a cloud, only two graceful thinning ribbons of sea foam with small breaks and trailing flecks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART sprite for a ship game's reply indicator, genuine transparent background. One small friendly slate-blue shark swimming to the RIGHT in side view, mostly above the waterline, with an ivory speech bubble floating above its back. The bubble has three simple dark navy square dots, NO text. Broad rounded snout, dark dorsal fin, pale blue belly, single tiny dark eye, calm closed mouth, clear forked tail, a few tiny teal water pixels at its belly. Classic handcrafted 16-bit game sprite, dark navy one-pixel outline at logical size, chunky clean pixel clusters, just 8-12 colours, deliberately simple and very readable. Final logical sprite about 56x40 pixels with shark in lower 22px and bubble in upper 16px. Center it with generous transparent margins on a 1024x1024 canvas. Absolutely no scenery, no ocean rectangle, no glow, no shadow, no gradients, no antialiasing, no soft transparency inside the body or bubble. Opaque sprite pixels and completely clear empty space. Match warm wooden Japanese ship and blue-green coastal water. Only ONE shark and ONE speech bubble.
